prompt: Create an original 180 second instrumental neo-soul instrumental composition for rest, unwinding and breathing exercises. Mood: peaceful, soft, spacious. Instruments: electric piano, electric bass, clean guitar, drums. Style: pocket groove with syncopated seventh chords. Tempo approximately 72 BPM; F major. Main idea: alternating short and long phrases. Use a restrained arrangement, soft attacks, no sudden accents. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-01:00] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [01:00-02:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [02:00-03:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 03:00.

description.en: A smooth, mellow instrumental track featuring clean electric guitars, a walking bassline, and light drums, with subtle synth pads adding atmosphere. It has a relaxed, jazzy, and chill-out vibe.
description.zh: 一首流畅、柔和的纯音乐，以干净的电吉他、行进贝斯线和轻柔的鼓点为主，辅以微妙的合成器铺垫营造氛围。整体氛围轻松、爵士且 Chill-out。

metadataBasis: style/scenario/tempo/key/moods are prompt intent; duration is measured; energy and audioReview are model inference when energyBasis is automated-audio-review
